procedure.title: Non-invasive upper-arm blood-pressure measurement (educational demonstration)
procedure.purpose: Demonstrates how a non-medical crew member could be guided to take an automatic upper-arm blood-pressure reading for a configured, fictional assessment.
compatible_device_models: Demo Automatic Upper-Arm BP Monitor A1
procedure.source_basis: Paraphrased from widely published general guidance for automatic home upper-arm blood-pressure measurement (for example American Heart Association home-monitoring guidance). Not reviewed by a flight surgeon and not a mission-approved procedure.
safety_limitations: Educational demonstration only. Not a clinically validated or mission-approved procedure.
Do not use this procedure to diagnose or treat any condition.
Stop if the cuff causes pain, numbness or tingling, and release the cuff.
If you feel chest pain, severe headache, faintness or shortness of breath, stop and activate the emergency workflow or call a crew member.
Confirming a step records an acknowledgement only. It does not prove the step was performed correctly.

steps.title: Prepare and rest
steps.instruction: Restrain yourself in a relaxed, supported position. Rest quietly for 5 minutes. Avoid exercise, caffeine and talking during this time.
steps.responder_note: Help the crew member into a supported, relaxed position.

steps.title: Expose the upper arm
steps.instruction: Use the left upper arm unless instructed otherwise. Remove or roll up tight clothing so the cuff sits on bare skin.
steps.responder_note: Ask before touching the crew member's arm.

steps.title: Position the cuff
steps.instruction: Wrap the cuff snugly around the upper arm with its lower edge about 2-3 cm above the elbow crease. Align the cuff's artery marker with the inside of the arm. Two fingertips should fit under the cuff.
steps.responder_note: Check the fit with two fingertips.

steps.title: Support the arm at heart level
steps.instruction: Keep the arm relaxed and supported at about heart level. Keep still and do not talk.
steps.responder_note: Support the arm gently if needed.

steps.title: Start the measurement
steps.instruction: Press start on the monitor and remain still until the cuff fully deflates.
steps.responder_note: Start the device and watch for errors on the display.

steps.title: Record the displayed values
steps.instruction: Read the systolic, diastolic and pulse values shown on the display, remove the cuff and submit the reading.
steps.responder_note: Read the values aloud to the crew member before submitting.

emergency_scenario.description: Fictional scenario based on the challenge example: DEMO-001 reports chest pain and collapses. DEMO-002 activates the emergency workflow. Localisation is unavailable.
